verdict.rationale: The evidence only approximates this story. Mailchimp Transactional sends 'event-driven messages via the API' to individual recipients, the Marketing API uses 'custom data pulled directly from your app', and the pricing page mentions automations. Nothing documents a custom-event endpoint or an automation/journey trigger tied to a specific contact. missing for 10: documented custom events API, automation triggered by a custom event for a single contact, event payload/personalization details, hands-on corroboration.
